extDescription.message: Lightweight YouTube-only video ad blocker. Skips pre-roll, mid-roll and overlay ads without touching any other website.

compatBody.message: YouTube flagged an ad blocker, so tracking-related blocks were turned off to keep videos playing.

compatSince.message: Since {0}. Strict mode is retried automatically after 7 days and after every update.

healthBody.message: Ads were detected but could not be handled. Check for an extension update.

healthPersists.message: YouTube still shows its ad blocker warning. Check for an extension update.

channelsHint.message: On allowed channels this extension steps aside: ads are not skipped and their network requests are not blocked in that tab. It starts working again as soon as you open another channel.

channelNone.message: Open a YouTube video to allow its channel.

hint.message: Works only on youtube.com. Changes apply instantly.
